voice.description: Which model produced this set, e.g. 'codex/gpt-5.5' or 'claude/code-reviewer'

target.description: What was reviewed (path, PR, design doc, or proposal text)

id.description: Short stable id, e.g. C1, I3 — unique within this voice

location.description: file:line or section; empty string if not applicable (e.g. a proleptic objection)

body.description: The finding plus a one-line 'why it matters'

needs_research.description: true if confirming/refuting this needs external info you cannot access offline

research_question.description: What to look up, if needs_research is true; empty otherwise
